info.title: MICROSERVICE-testDev-Create Catalog Seafood Produce Detail-v1-spec
info.description: The Seafood Produce Detail Management API enables businesses to efficiently manage and create detailed entries for seafood produce. This API facilitates the addition of new product information, including descriptions, classifications, and attributes vital for inventory and sales. Typical consumers of this API include e-commerce platforms, suppliers, and seafood retailers looking to enhance their catalog. By utilizing this API, users can ensure they have accurate and comprehensive data for their seafood offerings.

post.description: This endpoint allows you to submit detailed information about seafood produce. Ensure that all necessary fields are filled out accurately to facilitate processing. You can include various aspects of the produce such as species, origin, and quality metrics.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to submit details related to seafood produce. Please ensure that the data adheres to the specified schema for successful processing.

200.description: Request completed successfully and returned seafood produce details.

CreateCatalogSeafoodProduceDetailRequest.title: Seafood Produce Details Request

seafood_produce_id.description: Unique identifier for the seafood produce.

requestedBy.description: Name of the person or entity requesting the produce.

quantity.description: The quantity of seafood produce being requested.

isPriority.description: Indicates if the request is of high priority.

unitPrice.description: The unit price of the seafood produce.

CreateCatalogSeafoodProduceDetailRequest.description: Request body schema for creating or updating details about seafood produce operations.
